why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Axiom app Launch Axiom from the Launch Axiom link on the homepage, which leads to the Axiom app .
2 Step 2 : Trade on the platform Place trades through Axiom, since trading is the first way its homepage says Axiom Points are earned. Trading also earns SOL rewards.
3 Step 3 : Use the referral feature Share Axiom through its referral feature, which the homepage lists as a way to earn points and SOL from friends.
4 Step 4 : Complete quests Take on the quests Axiom offers, the third source of Axiom Points named on its homepage .
